rows.grounds: reduplicated compound nava+nava with indeclinable iha indicating continual freshness in the present locus
manifest power or splendor unfolded by the self
compound sva+bhitti denoting one's own substrate or foundation
compound sva+ātman identifying the agent as one's very self
act of opening or manifesting ever-new glory
vocative compound addressing the supreme lord

items.question: On what ground does the supreme lord unfold ever-new glory as one's own self?
premises: The unfolding is ever-new and occurs here.
The glory is manifested on one's own ground.
The agent of unfolding is one's own self, addressed as lord of lords.
items.inference: The supreme lord's ever-new glory is not external but unfolds here on the ground of one's own self.
uncertainties: bhitti may suggest wall, canvas, or substrate; rendered as ground to fit the interiorization context.
items.plain_english: O Lord of lords, your own self unfolds ever-new glory here on your own ground.
